title: Dispatch
overview: After losing his career as the famous hero Mecha Man, Robert Robertson is forced to take a desk job dispatching a team of reformed supervillains across Los Angeles. As he struggles to manage the dysfunctional Z-Team, rebuild his own life, and uncover secrets tied to his past, workplace drama, unlikely friendships, and city-threatening dangers collide in a superhero comedy-drama where every choice can shape the future of the team.
